# Preview background and lighting

`garden.jpg` and `garden.hdr` are "Charolettenbrunn Park" by Poly Haven
(https://polyhaven.com/a/charolettenbrunn_park), CC0.

- `garden.jpg`: the tonemapped JPG, resized to 2048×1024. The interactive 3D
  preview shows it as the ground and sky around the house.
- `garden.hdr`: the 1k HDR of the same place. Both previews light the house
  with it. A JPG has no real sun or sky brightness, so lighting from it
  looked flat and took on the lawn's green.
